headline: Seattle Pacific and Western Washington keep perfect records
dek: Both sides have won every match they have played, and Seattle Pacific have scored ten goals in three of them. Northwest Nazarene are unbeaten too, without a win to show for it.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Saint Martin's twelve goals are more than Northwest Nazarene and Simon Fraser have scored together.

wire.line: Northwest Nazarene have drawn all three of their matches.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Three matches whose dates have passed carry no result, and every one of them is a Simon Fraser home match from August.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Saint Martin's own the conference's three box score gaps: results published, detail the collector could not reach.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Archie Dhima, a freshman forward, has four goals from ten shots for Western Oregon.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Connor Leistiko holds the conference's only shutouts, two of them, for Saint Martin's.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Western Oregon have scored nine and conceded nine, with one win, two draws and one loss.

last_match.line: Western Oregon have not won since their opening match.

next_match.line: Seattle Pacific have yet to drop a point; Point Loma arrive from a defeat at Western Washington.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
